What is the PICO question for this patient? (Teacher note: the PICO stands for Patient, Intervention, Control, Outcomes. It is widely used in the evidence-based medicine field. The instructor could explain PICO in 1-2 min if the team is unfamiliar to PICO term)

P=an 80 y/o healthy robust man with newly diagnosis of hypertension (stage II) without any organ damage

I=antihypertensive medication or non-drug therapy such as diet change

C=no treatment or keep active as it is

O=prevent a stroke (prevent complications), have an active and healthy life with his wife, and prolong life (mortality benefit)
